items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Vernon Roulette' only in the context of the interviewee's friend Zutty Singleton wanting to work with him. The interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship with Vernon Roulette.

ctx.x: I know that was your first job because, boy, he was so hurt because I had to play with this other band and everything, and he was so jealous and (inaudible). Life was miserable, really. (Inaudible) this other band.

He said he knew musicians and he how they were AFTER me... (unintelligible). Soon as he said he was going to work with Vernon Roulette (unintelligible). Oh, yeah, and then I had another job. I quit the day -- I was working as a manicurist. Zutty was jealous of that job. He said (unintelligible). He said he going to work with Vernon Roulette was (unintelligible) I told the barber shop man I wouldn't be to work no more. Finished.
